items.title: Nvidia scandal could help China long-term, and risks in the AI trade
items.summary:
Deidre Bosa tackles the hottest tech and AI headlines, beginning with the long-term win China might get from the Nvidia (NVDA) scandal. Risks in the AI trade and how this all could affect the US-China relationship.

Deidre Bosa then sits down with Sierra co-founder Clay Bavor and OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) chairman Bret Taylor to discuss doubts about the data center rollout and the competition between the US and China in the AI race.

'Deirdre Bosa Live' airs every day at 4 p.m. Tune in daily to hear how the latest developments in AI and technology are reshaping companies, industries, and the global economy.
